say:3:1510405002:0.text: So, this is a human city...

say:4:1510405003:0.text: Everybody, please hold on for a moment. You can't go into the city like this.
say:4:1510405003:0.source_cn: 各位，请停步。你们不能这样进城。

say:5:1510405004:1.text: Especially you, Herdmaster. The Halians have no love for the Wildborn, and certainly not their god.
say:5:1510405004:1.source_cn: 尤其是你，狩猎神，呼临不欢迎兽人，更不欢迎他们的神。
say:5:1510405004:1.male: Especially you, Herdmaster. The Halians have no love for the Wildborn, and certainly not their god.
say:5:1510405004:1.female: Especially you, Herdmaster. The Halians have no love for the Wildborn, and certainly not their goddess.

choice_prompt:6:1510405004.female: Especially you, Herdmaster. The Halians have no love for the Wildborn, and certainly not their goddess.

say:9:1510405006:0.text: Herdmaster, you can pass yourself off as a member of the Arcane Council. It's the perfect disguise for you.
say:9:1510405006:0.source_cn: 神啊，你可以伪装为魔法师协会的一员。这是个很适宜你的身份。
say:9:1510405006:0.male: Herdmaster, you can pass yourself off as a member of the Arcane Council. It's the perfect disguise for you.
say:9:1510405006:0.female: Herdmaster, you can pass yourself off as a member of the Arcane Council. It's the perfect disguise for you.

say:10:1510405007:0.text: These are <style="highlight">the robes of the Arcane Council. Go ahead and put them on</style>. Long have I sought a third member and yet never did I imagine destiny would have us cross paths like this. A curious twist of fate, indeed.
say:10:1510405007:0.source_cn: 这是<style=highlight>魔法师协会的长袍...
say:10:1510405007:0.male: These are <style="highlight">the robes of the Arcane Council. Go ahead and put them on</style>. Long have I sought a third member and yet never did I imagine destiny would have us cross paths like this. A curious twist of fate, indeed.
say:10:1510405007:0.female: These are <style="highlight">the robes of the Arcane Council. Go ahead and put them on</style>. Long have I sought a third member and yet never did I imagine destiny would have us cross paths like this. A curious twist of fate, indeed.

say:12:1510405009:0.text: We can present her as a Wildborn prisoner taken from Mirehold, offered in service to the Arcane Council.
say:12:1510405009:0.source_cn: 她是我从水泽营地带回的兽人俘虏。魔法师协会的仆人。

say:16:1510405011:0.text: I admit this is less than ideal, but we have no other options.
say:16:1510405011:0.source_cn: 这方式确实不妥，但是没有别的办法。

say:17:1510405012:0.text: Embrace your new role, or neither you nor your god will set foot in Halia.
say:17:1510405012:0.source_cn: 接受你的新身份，不然你和你的神都进不了呼临城。
say:17:1510405012:0.male: Embrace your new role, or neither you nor your god will set foot in Halia.
say:17:1510405012:0.female: Embrace your new role, or neither you nor your goddess will set foot in Halia.

say:23:1510405017:0.text: You can do this. Just remember to never reveal who you really are or the Herdmaster's true identity.
say:23:1510405017:0.source_cn: ……就这样吧。记住，绝对不能透露你和狩猎神的真实身份。
say:23:1510405017:0.male: You can do this. Just remember to never reveal who you really are or the Herdmaster's true identity.
say:23:1510405017:0.female: You can do this. Just remember to never reveal who you really are or the Herdmaster's true identity.

say:24:1510405018:0.text: Otherwise, I can't guarantee what will happen.
say:24:1510405018:0.source_cn: 否则，我无法保证会发生什么。

say:27:1510405019:0.text: What's the plan after this, Lady Merlin?
say:27:1510405019:0.source_cn: 之后的行动计划，梅林女士？

say:28:1510405020:0.text: My colleague <style="highlight">Morgan</style> has been studying the fallen gods and divine corruption near Halia's outskirts. By now, he's probably uncovered something useful.

say:29:1510405021:0.text: If we apply his findings, we might be able to tweak things with magic and at least ease Halia's immediate crisis.
say:29:1510405021:0.source_cn: 结合他的结论，我们或许能用魔法对现状做出一些改变，至少...

say:30:1510405022:0.text: Alright, I'll do everything I can to cover for you.
say:30:1510405022:0.source_cn: 那么，我会尽力给你们做掩护。

choice:19:0:1.text: Listen to him for once, Gala.
choice:19:0:1.male: Listen to him for once, Gala.
choice:19:0:1.female: Listen to him for once, Gala.

choice:19:1:2.text: Who is this Herdmaster? I have a name.
choice:19:1:2.male: Who is this Herdmaster? I have a name.
choice:19:1:2.female: Who is this Herdmaster? I have a name.

choice:19:2:3.text: Try calling me by my human name.
choice:19:2:3.source_cn: 试试看，用我的名字称呼我
choice:19:2:3.male: Try calling me by my human name.
choice:19:2:3.female: Try calling me by my human name.

say:33:1510405005:0.text: Let's call you and your emissary by something else.
say:33:1510405005:0.source_cn: 换个称呼，连同你的神使一起。
say:33:1510405005:0.male: Let's call you and your emissary by something else.
